social_circle.name: Priya Raman

demographics.occupation: undergraduate HCI and computer science student; part-time campus research assistant
demographics.education: currently pursuing a bachelor's degree in Computer Science and Human-Computer Interaction

background.how_they_met: Priya met Kyle through college hackathon and creative technology circles, including the interactive projection project that helped Kyle commit to mixing code and visual art.
background.why_close: Priya is the organized friend who helps Kyle turn vague anxiety into concrete tasks. They share interests in HCI, creative coding, collaborative projects, and keeping each other grounded during school-to-work transitions.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts in clear, short bursts with checklists, calendar screenshots, and gentle but firm reminders. Uses a few emojis but mostly practical language.

shared_activities: talking through stress and job applications
recent_text_topics: Breaking Kyle's job search into smaller tasks after he sent about fifteen applications and started drifting into portfolio work.
Debugging memories from Kyle's final project push, especially the noisy sensor input and lagging visuals.
Checking whether Kyle has slept, eaten real food, and replied to messages when he starts avoiding tasks.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q02 says Priya was on the hackathon team and was 'great at keeping everyone from drifting too far off task.' Q44 says Priya came over, made Kyle list what was actually due, and helped fix one bug at a time. Q49 says Kyle texts 'usually Priya or my mom' when stressed.
